steps.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.

Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. In a large pan, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breasts and cook for about 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through. Remove from the pan and let rest for a few minutes before slicing.
In the same pan, add the cooked pasta, pesto, and Parmesan cheese. Stir well to combine and warm through.
Serve the pesto pasta topped with sliced chicken breasts and cherry tomatoes if desired. Enjoy your delicious lunch!
